# Belgarum Property Management

> Block and estate management company based in Winchester, Hampshire, managing residential blocks and estates across Hampshire and the south of England since 1989. Belgarum Property Management Limited, company number 07580603.

We work for residents' management companies (RMCs), right to manage (RTM) companies, freeholders, private landlords and developers. Each building's service charge money is held in its own designated trust account. Office hours: Monday to Thursday, 9am to 5pm; Friday, 9am to 4.30pm. Phone 0800 298 0069, email management@bpmanagement.org.

## Services

- [Block and estate management](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/services/block-and-estate-management/): Dedicated property manager, money held in trust, legal admin handled
- [Service charge budgets](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/services/service-charge-budgets/): How budgets and reserve funds are set
- [Service charge accounts](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/services/service-charge-accounts/): Collection, arrears and year-end accounts
- [Section 20 consultation](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/services/section-20-consultation/): The £250 limit, notices and comment periods
- [Major works](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/services/major-works/): Reserve funds, consultation and contractor tendering
- [Repairs and maintenance](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/services/repairs-and-maintenance/): How to report a repair and who pays
- [Fire and building safety](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/services/fire-and-building-safety/): Fire risk, asbestos and health and safety assessments
- [Company secretarial](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/services/company-secretarial/): Company secretary services for RMCs
- [Leasehold sale packs](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/services/leasehold-sale-packs/): How sellers and solicitors order an LPE1 pack

## Who we work with

- [RMC and RTM directors](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/who-we-work-with/rmc-and-rtm-directors/)
- [Freeholders and private landlords](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/who-we-work-with/freeholders-and-private-landlords/): Blocks from 4 flats up
- [Developers](https://www.belgarum-property.co.uk/who-we-work-with/developers/): Management planned before the first sale
